# Architecture decisions

<!-- GENERATED by .claude/skills/spec/scripts/gen-adr-index.sh — do not edit. -->

## Live

* [ADR-001-XEWL: One pure-Python core with a Blender and a glTF backend](adr-001-xewl-shared-python-core.md) - The house is described once in code/house_core.py plus its sub-model modules (code/ofen.py stoves, code/desk.py desk, code/bad.py Bad Großeltern, code/kueche.py Küche, code/gaeste_wc.py Gäste-WC, code/regal.py Schrank im Büro, code/schrankbett.py Schrankbett, code/gaestebad.py Gästebad, code/elternbad.py Bad Nadine & Till; no bpy); build_house.py (Blender) and export_gltf.py (glTF for the web viewer) are backends that only turn its Blueprint into output. (accepted, 2026-11-03)
* [ADR-002-MLQS: Own stdlib glTF writer with procedural material parameters in extras](adr-002-mlqs-gltf-own-writer.md) - The viewer's .glb is written by our own standard-library Python (triangulation, outward orientation, _RND attribute, MAT_DEF in material extras), generated at build time and never committed. (accepted, 2026-11-03)
* [ADR-003-SKGB: WebGPURenderer with TSL node materials for the viewer](adr-003-skgb-webgpu-tsl.md) - The viewer renders with three.js WebGPURenderer and builds its procedural materials and stage blending as TSL node graphs, relying on the automatic WebGL2 fallback. (accepted, 2026-11-03)
* [ADR-004-CTPY: Offline web app: a build-generated precaching service worker](adr-004-ctpy-offline-precache-service-worker.md) - The production build ships a service worker (sw.js, generated after vite build from the files in web/dist) that stores every file of the build on first visit and answers from that store, so the viewer runs offline, e.g. as a home-screen app on the iPad; dev pages register none. (accepted, 2026-11-20)
* [ADR-005-JXWL: Plan versions: committed source snapshots, built by their own exporter](adr-005-jxwl-plan-versions-source-snapshots.md) - A plan version is a committed tar.gz snapshot of code/ and plans/ (versionen/<id>.tar.gz, listed in versionen/versionen.json); the build turns each into its house .glb with the snapshot's own export_gltf.py and copies its plan sheets, and the current viewer must load every listed version. (proposed, 2026-11-25)
